AISMessage.description: One structured message in an AI conversation transcript.

TIMESTAMP_UTC.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the message was created.

TOOL_CALL_ID.description: Correlating tool-call identifier when ROLE is TOOL or ASSISTANT.

TOOL_NAME.description: Tool name when associated with a tool invocation.

AISToolCall.description: One structured tool call and optional result captured during a model turn.

RESULT_TEXT.description: Serialized or summarized tool result returned to the model.

IS_ERROR.description: True when the tool invocation returned an error.

DURATION_MS.description: Wall-clock duration of the tool execution in milliseconds.

AISHeader.description: One non-credential HTTP header observed by the collecting edge/server.

NAME.description:
Lowercase HTTP header name (collector strips Authorization, Proxy-Authorization,
Cookie, Set-Cookie, X-Api-Key, X-Auth-Token, X-SDN-Token, CF-Access-JWT-Assertion,
and CF-Access-Client-Secret before persisting).

SESSION_ID.description: Stable session identifier grouping all events in one AI conversation.

REQUEST_ID.description: Identifier correlating one user query with its model turns, tools, and answer.

TURN_INDEX.description: 0-based model loop turn index within REQUEST_ID.

RECEIVED_UTC.description: Server-stamped RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when received by the SDN collector.

RECEIVED_UNIX_MS.description: Server-stamped Unix epoch milliseconds when received by the SDN collector.

CLIENT_UTC.description: Client-observed RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the event occurred.

CLIENT_UNIX_MS.description: Client-observed Unix epoch milliseconds when the event occurred.

CLIENT_IP.description: Authoritative client IP extracted server-side from edge headers or socket remote.

CLIENT_IP_HASH.description:
Unsalted lowercase hex SHA-256 hash of the normalized CLIENT_IP used as a
deterministic grouping key (not an anonymization barrier for IPv4).

REMOTE_ADDR.description: Raw TCP remote ip:port observed by the SDN HTTP listener.

X_FORWARDED_FOR.description: Raw X-Forwarded-For chain observed by the SDN HTTP listener.

CF_COUNTRY.description: Cloudflare CF-IPCountry ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

CF_REGION.description: Cloudflare edge region or subdivision code.

CF_ASN.description: Edge-reported Autonomous System Number verbatim (e.g. "AS7922" or numeric ASN).

HTTP_REFERER.description: Server-observed HTTP Referer header (query string stripped by collector).

SDN_SIGNED_IN.description: True when the requester had an active signed-in SDN session at event time.

SDN_IDENTITY_SCHEME.description: Public identity scheme (e.g. hd-wallet, ed25519, secp256k1, external-wallet).

SDN_SIGN_IN_METHOD.description: Sign-in method metadata (e.g. wallet-passkey, wallet-mnemonic, external-eip1193).

SDN_PUBLIC_KEY_HEX.description: Requester public key in lowercase hex (never private key material).

SDN_KEY_ID.description: Requester public key identifier, fingerprint, or libp2p peer ID.

SDN_DERIVATION_PATH.description: Non-secret BIP-32/SLIP-10 derivation path metadata when present.

EXTERNAL_WALLET_ADDRESS.description: Connected external wallet public address when present.

EXTERNAL_WALLET_NAME.description: Connected external wallet provider name (e.g. MetaMask, Phantom).

EXTERNAL_WALLET_CHAIN.description: Connected external wallet chain identifier (e.g. eip155:1).

FINGERPRINT_HASH.description: Composite lowercase hex SHA-256 browser fingerprint hash.

INSTALL_ID.description: Persistent first-party browser installation UUID across sessions.

PAGE_URL.description: Sanitized client page URL/route at event time.

APP_VERSION.description: Client application build version or revision.

TZ_OFFSET_MIN.description: UTC offset in minutes from Date.prototype.getTimezoneOffset() (meaningful when FINGERPRINT_HASH is set).

SCREEN_WIDTH.description: Physical display width in CSS pixels (screen.width).

SCREEN_HEIGHT.description: Physical display height in CSS pixels (screen.height).

VIEWPORT_WIDTH.description: Browser viewport width in CSS pixels (window.innerWidth).

VIEWPORT_HEIGHT.description: Browser viewport height in CSS pixels (window.innerHeight).

DEVICE_MEMORY_GB.description: Approximate device memory in GiB (navigator.deviceMemory, 0 if unavailable).

CANVAS_HASH.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 hash of deterministic 2D canvas fingerprint.

AUDIO_HASH.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 hash of deterministic audio context fingerprint.

FONT_HASH.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 hash of deterministic browser font-metrics probe.

COOKIES_ENABLED.description: True when browser reports navigator.cookieEnabled (meaningful when FINGERPRINT_HASH is set).

WEBDRIVER.description: True when browser reports navigator.webdriver (meaningful when FINGERPRINT_HASH is set).

LOCAL_STORAGE_WRITABLE.description: True when browser localStorage was writable at probe time (meaningful when FINGERPRINT_HASH is set).

MODEL_PROVIDER.description: Configured AI provider identifier (e.g. spaceaware-proxy, anthropic, openai).

MODEL_ID.description: Model identifier used for this request or turn.

PROMPT_TEXT.description: User prompt or query text submitted to the AI.

ANSWER_TEXT.description: Assistant answer or turn output text.

SUMMARY_TEXT.description: Concise summary or card title produced for the answer.

ERROR_CODE.description: Machine-readable error code when STATUS indicates failure.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Human-readable error message when STATUS indicates failure.

INPUT_TOKENS.description: Prompt/input token count reported by the provider.

OUTPUT_TOKENS.description: Completion/output token count reported by the provider.

TOTAL_TOKENS.description: Total token count reported by the provider.

COST_USD.description: Provider-reported or estimated request cost in USD (0 when unreported).

TOOL_CALL_COUNT.description: Number of tool calls executed in this turn or request.

COLLECTOR_NODE_ID.description: Server-stamped SDN collector node peer ID or hostname.

MESSAGES.description: Structured conversation messages captured with this event.

TOOL_CALLS.description: Structured tool invocations and results captured with this event.

EDGE_HEADERS.description: Non-credential HTTP headers observed by the collecting SDN node.
